proposal_1.claim: In this continuously-traded tape the overnight gap is structurally zero on weekdays and material only across weekend / block-open seams. Emit a gap-vs-session split ONLY on Mondays and block-opens; on every other day the split is arithmetic theatre and the day-move IS the session.
proposal_1.evidence: All 20 staged sessions across g22 and g23, per-event. Sixteen weekday seams: |gap| values 0, 10, 20, 0, 10, 0, 0, 0, 0, 10, 0, 0, 0, 0, 10, 10 - maximum 20 USD, i.e. two ticks, which is the render's own resolution. Four weekend / block-open seams: 1,210 (g22 0622), 50 (g22 0629), 580 (g23 0706), 360 (g23 0713).
proposal_1.n: 20 sessions, 2 groups, spans groups. Structural rather than statistical - it follows from the ~23-hour session.

proposal_2.id: boundary.weekend_gap_wide_band_emission - SPLIT THE SIGN FROM THE BAND
proposal_2.claim: The play currently fuses a sign claim to a magnitude band and emits a one-sided band. Split it: emit the gap MAGNITUDE as a signless band from the sigma x book-state rung, and emit the gap SIGN as a separate, separately-scored instrument. Score the two independently.
proposal_2.evidence: My day is the clean demonstration. The magnitude arm was RIGHT (|actual gap| 580 sits inside the |150..700| band the play derived from a 0.5-1.0x era-degraded sigma, and the mid-book rung was correctly preferred to the 1.5-2.5x extreme rung). The sign arm was WRONG. Because the band is one-sided, a correct magnitude read scored as a 730 USD miss outside the near edge. Across the four weekend seams in g22+g23, the |150..700| band would contain |gap| on 2 of 4 (580, 360) and miss 2 (1,210, 50) - so the band's width is mediocre on its own and its usable content is being destroyed by a sign error it does not need to carry.
proposal_2.falsifier: A group in which the fused emission scores better than the split emission on gap error - i.e. where the sign and magnitude arms are genuinely correlated.

proposal_3.claim: SCOPE REFINEMENT to C's numb-class rule (which I corroborate out-of-sample), not a competing rule. A numb prior-session terminal coefficient bounds the next day's NET and says nothing useful about its RANGE. It is a net-suppressor, not a volatility-suppressor. A desk sizing a quiet day off it will be right about the close and badly wrong about the path.
proposal_3.evidence: Numb seams in g22+g23 (|k3_prev| <= 0.05), per instance: 0703->0706 net +100 on a range of 970 (ratio 9.7) with a 960 USD turn and a low 840 below the anchor; 0713->0714 net +200 range 780 (3.9); 0714->0715 net -60 range 760 (12.7); 0715->0716 net -20 range 1,450 (72.5). Against the non-numb days in the same two groups: median |net| 520 and median range 1,350, ratios 1.2 to 5.0. The numb class compresses the NET by 6.5x (median |net| 80 vs 520) but the RANGE by only 1.5x (875 vs 1,350). CORROBORATION of C's underlying rule: my seam is an independent instance in a day-class C did not sample (a 3-night holiday seam Monday) and it lands in class at +100 <= 200; all four numb seams in g22+g23 land in class.
proposal_3.n: 4 numb instances measured here spanning g22-g23, against a 15-session non-numb comparison in the same two groups. C reports further instances in g20, so the underlying rule spans three groups.
proposal_3.declared_weakness: My own instance measures k3_prev on 489 lots against C's stated >=500-lot floor. It is a boundary instance by 2 percent and should be counted as such.
proposal_3.scope: Next-day NET only. Explicitly silent on sign (C's own refusal, which I keep) and now explicitly silent on range.
proposal_3.falsifier: A numb seam (|k3_prev| <= 0.05, |ph3 flow| >= 500) whose next session both nets >= 700 USD and does so without an exogenous catalyst - which would break the net claim; or a run of numb seams whose ranges compress as hard as their nets, which would break this refinement.

proposal_4.id: monday.catchup_window_is_a_sell_window_not_a_ratification_window - RETIRE the ratification arm of the B lens
proposal_4.claim: The 06:00-10:00 ET Monday window does not ratify or reverse the overnight according to the overnight's sign. On the available evidence it contributes negatively regardless of the day's direction, and it is not where Monday's magnitude is decided. Retire the ratification arm; keep the window as a small, one-sided drag term; move the lens's attention to the seam.
proposal_4.evidence: Four Mondays, both staged groups, measured off the realized continuous curves: 0622 -710, 0629 -510, 0706 -50, 0713 -360. Negative 4 of 4, median -435. The two adjacent sub-periods each split 2-2 (pre-06 +500/-490/+390/-100; 10-close -350/-160/+340/+200), so the window is the only unanimous sub-period of a Monday. It is negative on both Mondays that closed UP on the day, i.e. it trades against the day's own direction. On 0706 it contributed -50 of a +880 advance, all of which arrived outside the window.
proposal_4.scope: Regular and block-open Mondays on the staged NG legs.

This is the reason the proposal is worded as 'retire the ratification arm' (which is 0 for 2 and cannot be rescued by regime) rather than 'the window sells' (which can).

proposal_contribution.note: TEXT ONLY, no brain edit, per the run directive. Every item states its n and whether it spans groups. The general-mechanism bar is n>=2 SPANNING GROUPS and nothing here meets it, so nothing here is proposed for merge as a market play. Items 1-3 are OPERATING RULES about how a handed-down instrument is consumed - they are not market claims and do not carry a market n; their basis is the coordinator's own single-ownership guard plus one measured failure, and I say so rather than dressing them as findings. Items 4-6 are market/instrument observations with their n stated and their cross-group sweep named.

item_1_the_owners_read_precedes_the_verd.statement: A specialist who owns a day must produce and RECORD its own number, from its own lens and its own slice, BEFORE executing any handed-down conditional. Executing another specialist's test yields a LIMB STATE, never a sign. If the owner's read and the table's verdict disagree, both ship in the posterior along with which was taken and why; the disagreement is itself the measurement. A posterior whose sign is inherited must say so in the confidence field.
item_1_the_owners_read_precedes_the_verd.why_it_is_not_a_market_claim: It follows from the coordinator contract that already exists: the coordinator SELECTS one owner per day, never averages, and treats a wrong-owner posterior as a hard failure. Single ownership of the number and outsourcing of the sign are incompatible. This needs no market n because it asserts nothing about markets.
item_1_the_owners_read_precedes_the_verd.evidence: G23 0713. My blind posterior contains no independent number anywhere - the reasoning field opens by deriving the sign from E's table and explicitly disclaims authorship ('not by my override'). The cost is not only the 1,170 error: because no independent read was recorded, this refine cannot score the acceptance decision against an alternative and has to reconstruct it. n=1 measured failure, one block, one specialist.

item_2_a_declared_weak_limb_resolves_unr.statement: When a test limb's baseline or instrument is DECLARED contaminated - by the stager, by the owner, or by the state's own defect fields - the limb resolves UNREADABLE, not PASS and not FAIL. Weight-degradation in prose has no effect inside a binary verdict table; if the limb's vote cannot be degraded, its verdict must be. Corollary: MEASURABLE is not READABLE. A number served at the right period and the right age can still be unreadable if its comparator is contaminated.

clears_the_bar.statement: On an EIA Thursday that arrives at 10:29 carrying a chain-sided UP run of at least +300 from the prior close, the sixty seconds after 10:30 adjudicate the run. An impulse inside +/-300 confirms it and the day continues up; an impulse at or beyond -300 rejects it and the day round-trips the run in full and closes at or below flat. Do not carry a chain-sided sign THROUGH the print - carry it TO the print and let the first minute decide.
clears_the_bar.mechanism: The pre-print run is inventory, not conviction: it is built by desks positioning for the number. The print is the scheduled moment at which that inventory must be defended. A counter impulse means the inventory is being liquidated by the people who built it, which is why the round-trip overshoots rather than stopping at flat.
clears_the_bar.scope: Pre-print UP runs only. On the five Thursdays entering 10:29 with a run of -300 or worse, no sixty-second impulse reached |300| at all, so the rule has nothing to say there and must not be applied symmetrically.

item_1_depthless_overnight_is_not_a_flow.the_problem: As written, item 2 of my 0710 file triggers on 'near-zero net aggressor flow while price change is a large share of the session range'. 0717 ph1 superficially satisfies the spirit of that (big move, thin tape) and hands the OPPOSITE forward call. Left uncorrected, the proposal would have labelled an empty overnight a continuation signal.
item_1_depthless_overnight_is_not_a_flow.the_two_axes: Separate the objects on TWO measurements, both computable from the phase table alone. FLOW INTENSITY = |sflow| / vol. PRICE EFFICIENCY = |pxchg| per 1,000 lots. (a) LOW INTENSITY + ORDINARY EFFICIENCY + LARGE VOLUME SHARE = a WITHDRAWN book: real churn, no net transfer, an untested level -> CONTINUATION. (b) ORDINARY INTENSITY + OUTLIER EFFICIENCY + SMALL VOLUME SHARE = an ABSENT book: flow was transacted into no depth, no level was described -> ROUND TRIP.

item_1_depthless_overnight_is_not_a_flow.the_live_vs_blind_scoping_that_matters: Price efficiency is NOT computable by a price-masked blind agent. This rule therefore belongs to the POSTERIOR / LIVE layer, where price is visible in real time and the overnight phase's volume accrues in front of the operator - it is not a blind-side rule and must not be written as one. What IS expressible blind, from the same state, is the weaker consequence: on a shortened session with index rolls complete and no catalyst, FLATTEN the overnight p50 and WIDEN its band. That weaker form is what I emitted in path_p50_curve and it is worth 53 USD of mean node error against my own blind on this day.

item_5_the_zero_error_day_is_not_evidenc.kind: OPERATING RULE proposal (process, not market mechanism)
item_5_the_zero_error_day_is_not_evidenc.statement: A day's endpoint error must never be treated as evidence for or against the plays that produced it. Scoring is by endpoint; extrapolation is by mechanism; and on this day those two point in opposite directions. Concretely: when a posterior CONFIRMS a blind number, the confirmation must state which instruments survived and which were struck, and a play whose falsifier has fired elsewhere gains NOTHING from having been present on a zero-error day.
item_5_the_zero_error_day_is_not_evidenc.evidence: 20260717: blind error 0, and the burn_conversion_gate up-limb - refuted fence-clean on 0710 in both polarities - was one of three instruments in the derivation. Had this day been scored on endpoint alone the gate would have accumulated a supporting instance in the same block that killed it. The realized internals show the mechanism it asserted (burn-confirmed morning delivery) did not occur: the day's only conviction phase bought 130 USD with 1,157 net lots and handed 100 back.
item_5_the_zero_error_day_is_not_evidenc.the_symmetric_half: The rule cuts the other way too and must be applied that way. The crest-trim stand-down and the exit-location call on this day were CORRECT and would have been correct on a day with a 500-USD endpoint error. They earn their credit from the realized exit state (high 13:48, close 0.88 off the low, last hour negative in both price and flow), not from the scoreboard.
item_5_the_zero_error_day_is_not_evidenc.n_and_status: The PRINCIPLE is general; the INSTANCE is n=1 (this day). Proposed as an operating rule alongside my 0710 item 4 (a declared-degraded instrument must not set the magnitude class), which is the same family of failure: the scoreboard and the mechanism must be scored separately.
